Description: 

We’re seeking a Plant Manager - Asphalt who’s ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America.

 

**Job Title:** Plant Manager - Asphalt **| Req ID:** 18651 | **HR Contact:** Fredric Victor THOMPSON| **Location:** Stoughton MA

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

 

The Plant Manager is accountable for the leadership, development & management of all functions of the HMA manufacturing business at this location. The Plant Manager will ensure lean staffing and oversee safe production to enable plant productivity and maintenance in an efficient manner, while producing quality products for customers. The primary focus will be on safety, compliance and optimum manufacturingmaximizing productivity at the lowest cost of production. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising the activities of one or more asphalt plants. The Plant Manager communicates goals to department employees and ensures that goals are achieved. Maximizes employee participation to achieve the desired team approach. Develops departmental personnel to enhance skills, improve responsiveness and promote business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Coordinate the execution of general plant operations activities. Coordinate field management activities.
* Help coordinate activities such as transportation and receiving of product at the plant.
* Ensure that we produce quality products that meet or exceed customer expectations
* Inspect product quality ensuring all criteria meets plan. Recommend measures to improve production methods and equipment performance.
* Provides timely and accurate tickets for customers. Runs loader or dozer at bins and stock pile, and performs plant maintenance and housekeeping.
* Monitor, recommend, implements repairs and routine maintenance of equipment, buildings and grounds.
* Investigates abnormal operating events or equipment failures to determine cause; makes adjustments,repairs, and/or modifications as needed.
* Directly supervises 2 – 8 employees in the HMA division . Coach, train, mentor employees on the safe and efficient method of operating plant equipment. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees, planning, assigning and directing work rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Supports and assists personnel in achieving timely and
 
 efficient production schedules. Records employees’ time in online timekeeping system.
* Communicates and promotes safety, compliance and environmental requirements in alignment with company standards within production area. Monitors work performed and addresses situations that do not conform to standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
 
**Education:** Bachelor's degree or 6 years of equivalent experience
 
**Required Work Experience:** Minimum of six years of production-related work experience. Related supervisory or group leader experience preferred.
 
**Required Technical Skills:** Basic computer skills with ability to enter information in SAP and time recording software and working with Microsoft Office applications

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved. Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

card.title: Head of Validation - Manufacturing
card.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
  
 Gilead Sciences is seeking an experienced validation leader to head the Manufacturing Validation function at the Foster City site. This role will establish and lead an integrated, risk-based validation program for the facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems supporting a new state-of-the-art biologics facility. In partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Automation, IT, and project teams, this leader will define the validation framework, build the capabilities required for execution, and ensure the new facility is compliant and inspection-ready from startup through routine operations. The successful candidate will also lead and integrate the existing validation team supporting the site’s small-molecule clinical manufacturing pilot plants and warehouse. 
   
 Required Skills: 
 Demonstrated leadership of validation for the startup and licensure of a new biotech or biologics manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience designing and implementing risk-based, lifecycle validation approaches in a GMP-regulated environment. 
 Deep technical knowledge of facility, utility and equipment qualification and computer system validation, including applicable regulatory expectations and industry standards. 
 Proven ability to build validation organizations and governance, establish clear accountabilities, and lead employees, contractors, and partner functions through complex startup programs. 
 Strong cross-functional influence, decision-making, and communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to quality, data integrity, cGMP compliance, and patient safety. 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 

 Establish the site validation strategy 
Develop and implement an integrated, risk-based validation strategy, governance, acceptance criteria, and oversight model for facilities, utilities, process equipment, automation platforms, and GMP computer systems supporting the new Foster City biologics facility. 
 Lead validation through facility startup 
Provide site validation leadership and oversight from design and construction through commissioning, qualification, process readiness, and transition to routine GMP operations in alignment with the overall project schedule. 
 Implement risk-based validation 
Apply science- and risk-based principles to focus testing and documentation on critical aspects, leverage supplier and commissioning evidence where appropriate, and maintain clear traceability to patient, product, and data-integrity risks. 
 Build a high performing validation department
Provide leadership guidance and coaching for existing and new validation department employees, forecast and manage workload, and support employee career growth. 
 Build governance and execution capability 
Establish standards, procedures, templates, metrics, and decision forums; define roles across internal teams, engineering partners, vendors, and contractors; and develop a high-performing validation organization sized for each phase of the program. 
 Drive inspection readiness and sustainable operations 
Partner with Quality and system owners to ensure the new biologics facility and existing small molecule facilities are inspection-ready, including validation ownership, periodic review, change control, requalification, maintenance of the validated state, and continual improvement. 
  
 Qualifications: 

 Requires a Masters degree with 8+ years of relevant professional experience, or BS with 10+ years of relevant professional experience – a degree in a relevant scientific or business discipline is strongly preferred. 
 Hands-on experience implementing risk-based validation in a biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
 Excellent organizational and communication (both written and verbal) skills. 
 Demonstrated experience leading and engaging a team of technical experts. 
 
 The ideal candidate would also have:
 Significant experience with facility, equipment and utility qualification for startup of a manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience with computerized system validation in a biopharmaceutical environment. 
 Strategic thinking and ability to influence and constructively challenge the status quo. 
 
 
The salary range for this position is: $182,070.00 - $235,620.00. Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans*.

card.description:

For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 As part of Gilead's Enterprise Data and ERP strategy, we are seeking a Senior Manager, SAP Manufacturing and Planning to serve as the Product Owner for enterprise-wide manufacturing execution, production planning, and shop floor digitization capabilities across our pharmaceutical and biologics manufacturing network.  
 
This leader will define and execute the enterprise roadmap for S/4HANA Production Planning (PP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)/Digital Manufacturing, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and segmentation capabilities, while enabling GxP-compliant manufacturing transformation across Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Kite organizations. 

 This position will report to the Associate Director, IT ERP PDM. This is an onsite role based on Foster City, CA or Raleigh, NC. We do offer a hybrid environment with three days in office and two days work from home. 

  
 Key Responsibilities 

 Manufacturing Strategy & Business Partnership 
 Develop and articulate a comprehensive SAP Manufacturing solution roadmap that aligns with the company's long-term business objectives within the Life Sciences sector. 
 Architect scalable and flexible SAP solutions that can adapt to evolving business requirements and regulatory landscapes. 
 Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain leaders to define enterprise production priorities. 
 Establish standards, operating procedures, and best practices for production planning and shop floor execution. 
 Evaluate and recommend emerging SAP technologies and best practices to enhance system performance and efficiency 
 Drive manufacturing data quality, GxP compliance, standardization, and business value realization. 
 Produce detailed architectural blueprints, including data flow diagrams, system interface specifications, and configuration documentation. 
 Manufacturing & Platform Ownership 
 Own the strategy, governance, architecture, and continuous improvement of S/4HANA PP, MES/Digital Manufacturing, and MRP platforms across multiple sites. 
 Govern enterprise SAP manufacturing domains, including Production Orders, Routings, BOMs, Work Centers, Batch Management, and Shop Floor Integration.  
 Define enterprise standards for production planning, execution, and manufacturing data quality within a validated (GxP) environment.

**Job Title:** Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence

**Location:** Westfield, IN

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

 
 

We are seeking a hands-on transformation leader to drive enterprise-wide strategy, operating-model improvements, and value creation across a complex, multi-site industrial business. This role is a core member of the organizational leadership team, with a mandate to personally lead, structure, analyze, and execute transformation initiatives—working directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into measurable results.

 
 

This person will operate as a strategic problem solver and execution partner, identifying opportunities, building business cases, redesigning processes, and driving initiatives through implementation and value realization. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to building and leading a dedicated transformation team as the capability matures within the organization.

 
 

**OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Personally lead enterprise transformation and operating-model improvement initiatives from problem definition and strategy through execution and measurable value realization.
* Analyze business performance, identify operational and financial improvement opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve cost, quality, safety, delivery, and profitability.
* Lead and support M&A activities, including due diligence, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and synergy/value-capture initiatives.
* Build and maintain transformation roadmaps, business cases, financial models, project plans, KPIs, and governance mechanisms.
* Work directly with commercial, finance, and operations leaders to improve P&L performance, profitable growth, and value creation.
* Identify opportunities to modernize core systems and processes, including ERP/SAP, and evaluate AI-enabled and digital solutions based on measurable business impact.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, resolve complex business problems, and personally drive critical initiatives to completion.
* Collaborate with colleagues in our Strategy and Transformation office in Europe, contributing to globally coordinated initiatives and sharing best practices across geographies.
* Present findings, recommendations, progress, and results to executive leadership and other key stakeholders
 

 

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* 10+ years of experience in transformation, strategy, operations, management consulting, or operational excellence, ideally within industrial, manufacturing, automation, or supply-chain environments.
* Demonstrated experience personally driving complex transformation initiatives from analysis through implementation, rather than primarily overseeing teams or programs.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable results, including revenue growth, margin expansion, cost reduction, productivity improvements, and other value-creation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in operational excellence, Lean / Six Sigma, and structured problem solving; Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with M&A integration, operating-model design, process optimization, and value-capture initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen, including P&L, EBIT, business cases, ROI, planning, and financial modeling.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and execution skills with the ability to move from high-level strategy into detailed implementation.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* MBA from a leading program and/or an engineering background strongly preferred.
* Experience with AI-enabled / digital transformation and agentic GTM.
* Warehouse/manufacturing automation domain knowledge, including WES/MES, aftermarket service, or commercial project controlling.
* ERP/SAP implementation or optimization experience.
* Global / multi-continent experience, particularly US and APAC.
* Experience working in a PE-backed or highly performance-driven industrial environment.

**PROFESSIONAL QUALITIES**

* Hands-on and action-oriented, with a willingness to personally dive into analysis, problem-solving, and execution.
* Highly analytical and intellectually curious, with the ability to simplify complex business challenges and identify practical solutions.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility across all levels of the organization.
* Results-driven and accountable, with a strong focus on measurable business impact and value creation.
* Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and lead change without relying on direct authority.
 

 

**WORK CONDITIONS**

* Regular in-office collaboration with executive and cross-functional teams.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support business initiatives, operating locations, and global collaboration.
* Fast-paced, highly visible role requiring the ability to manage multiple strategic priorities and adapt as business needs evolve.
* Regular interaction with senior leadership and teams across functions, business units, and geographies.
 

 

**Why work for Storage Solutions – A Jungheinrich Company?**

At Storage Solutions, our greatest asset is our people. We have built a team of passionate intralogistics experts who collaborate and partner with distribution and fulfillment operations across North America and worldwide. We believe in providing tailored solutions for every square foot of an operation, and behind these solutions is a carefully selected team that shares our vision, culture, and core values.

We are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive. When you join us, you become part of a family that values your growth, well-being, and contributions. Together, we innovate, solve challenges, and celebrate successes.

 
 

**Additional Benefits**

* Competitive Salary and Bonus Structure
* Generous Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* Company HSA Contribution

 Job Description

 •  Strong strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder engagement capabilities

card.description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

* Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
* Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
* Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
* Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
* Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
* Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
* Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
* Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
* Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
* Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
* Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
* Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
* Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
* Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
* Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
* Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, trend analysis, reporting, and data visualization
* Experience with project management, resource planning, and systems implementation
* Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

**What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

* Experience using AI tools and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
* Background in technical, mechanical, electronics repair, refurbishment, or manufacturing environments
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher
* Experience working within ISO and OSHA-regulated environments
* Experience with Oracle ERP systems
* Experience supporting wireless or consumer electronics products

$144,700.00 - $241,600.00

Expected Application Deadline

01/04/2027

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

**What’s the culture like at Assurant?** 
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

**Company Overview** 
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

**AI and Biometric Usage** 
Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

**Job Scam Alert** 
Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords.

### **Job Description:**

Director, Executive Protection, Protective Operations and Logistics

The Role:

As the Director of Protective Operations and Logistics within the Executive Protection team, you will be responsible for executive protection program management and logistical planning, including staffing, scheduling*,* protective transportation operations, support request vetting and assessment, training administration, and oversight of the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program. Reporting to the Head of Executive Protection, you will provide operational leadership, program oversight, and subject matter expertise on executive protection and protective operations matters. You willbe responsible for ensuring the effective execution of day-to-day protective operations while supporting the continued enhancement of the firm's executive protection capabilities. The position requires close collaboration with Global Security Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Travel Security, and key internal and external partners to implement and support Fidelity's executive protection strategy. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational, leadership, and relationship-management skills, as well as the ability to balance competing priorities while delivering consistent, discreet, and service-oriented experience for Fidelity's senior leadership.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

* 7-10 years of experience protecting C-suite executives, board members, and/or government officials in complex, dynamic, and globally distributed operating environments within corporate, government, military, or law enforcement settings.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple workstreams
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, security professionals, and external stakeholders
* Extensive knowledge of executive protection operations, including protective advances, travel security, transportation security, venue assessment, route planning and protective operations logistics.
* Expertise in assessing, prioritizing, and coordinating executive support requests while balancing risk, resource requirements, and business priorities.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and operate effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, and high-pressure environments.
* Strong understanding of TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program requirements, administration, compliance, certifications, and operational integration; the ability to obtain and maintain ASO certification is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive protection staffing models, personnel scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple locations and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop, and build high-performing teams while fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and service excellence.
* Experience coordinating and supporting executive travel, special events, corporate meetings, and other high-visibility engagements requiring detailed planning and collaboration.
* Experience managing executive transportation programs, including vehicle operations, driver standards, fleet utilization, and transportation security protocols.
* Experience developing and managing executive protection training programs, operational exercises, performance standards, readiness assessments, and professional development initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CTM, CPP, PSP, ASIS Executive Protection Professional (EPP), TSA ASO, or other intelligence, investigation, or executive protection credentials are a plus.
* undefined

* Manage the day-to-day administration and logistical support of executive protection operations, including staffing, scheduling, executive travel, protective transportation, training, and resource allocation.
* Provide operational leadership and oversight for executive protection program management, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational readiness, and alignment with organizational priorities.
* Serve as a trusted partner to executive stakeholders by delivering responsive, discreet, and customer-focused protective services in support of business activities and executive requirements.
* Oversee the planning and coordination of executive travel, special events, site visits, and high-profile engagements, ensuring appropriate protective measures and logistical support are in place.
* Manage and enhance the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program, executive transportation services, training initiatives, and other core executive protection capabilities.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor to senior executives, providing strategic guidance, risk-based recommendations, and executive-level briefings on protective operations, emerging threats, and security-related matters.

The Executive Protection team is part of the broader Protective Services team, which in turn is part of Fidelity’s Global Security team. The Executive Protection team is a highly valued team dedicated to the protection of the firm’s executive leadership and events.

**Job Description**

Here at Thermo Fisher Scientific, our industry-leading scale means unparalleled commercial reach, unique customer access, and a global footprint. Our broad customer base—from research and clinical laboratories to commercial manufacturing—enables you to make a meaningful impact every day. Join our team and help build the capabilities that enable exceptional customer service across one of the world's largest scientific organizations.

**Location**: On-site in Tewksbury, MA is highly preferred; *potential* flexibility for remote candidates aligned to Eastern Time Zone. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Product Management & Global Operations** is responsible for defining and advancing the global capabilities that enable consistent, scalable, and industry-leading service delivery across Thermo Fisher Scientific's global service organization.

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

This leader establishes the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks that enable service excellence through standardized processes, knowledge management, digital service platforms, technical support, escalation management, and service lifecycle governance. Working across Product Management, Engineering, Digital, Commercial, Quality, and Regional Service organizations, the Global Service Capability Leader ensures service teams worldwide have the tools, processes, knowledge, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

Working across Product Management, Engineering, Digital, Commercial, Quality, and Regional Service organizations, the Global Service Capability Leader ensures service teams worldwide have the tools, processes, knowledge, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

Please contact us to request an accommodation.

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Reporting:** 
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Direct Reports:** 
Area Manager(s)

**Leadership Scope:** 
Provides leadership and oversight to all Operations team members, including Senior Multi-Unit Managers, Multi-Unit Managers, Hourly Managers, and Guest Service Hosts.

**Description:**

The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.

More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us *us*: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.

This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.

**Expectations:**

* Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
* Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
* Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
* Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
* Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
* Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Executive Leadership and Culture**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
* Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
* Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
* Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
* Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.

**Operations and Guest Experience**

* Take ownership of operations across all locations and establish company-wide standards for guest service, cleanliness, and sanitation.
* Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
* Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
* Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
* Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
* Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.

**People Management**

* Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
* Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.
* Maintain consistent communication with all levels of the organization, including in-person visits, camera monitoring, phone calls, and team meetings.
* Facilitate regular meetings with the Area Manager(s), Operations team, and business partners to ensure thorough follow-through on all business needs.
* Support a culture of continuous training and development for new and existing team members.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the company's operating P&L, including VGT performance and controllable expenses, ensuring results stay within budget while driving profitability.
* Develop annual operating budgets, and capital plans in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
* Analyze monthly P&Ls and key performance indicators and hold the leadership team accountable for results.
* Ensure strong internal controls over cash handling, deposit processes, and sales activities across all locations.

**Licensing, Compliance, and Regulatory Relations**

* Oversee the company's licensing and compliance program to ensure adherence to state and local regulations and standards.
* Serve as a key point of contact with regulators, including the Illinois Gaming Board (IGB), and maintain professional relationships with regulatory and local authorities.
* Uphold company policies and licensing standards, including liquor and gaming regulations, to protect employees and guests.
* Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by following local health codes and business license regulations.
* Ensure all employees complete required certification courses and that audits are completed and corrective actions are followed through.
* Reinforce a zero-tolerance standard to prohibit underage patrons from purchasing alcohol or gambling by IDing every guest, every time.

**Growth, Market Strategy, and Marketing**

* Identify and evaluate opportunities for growth, including new locations and market expansion.
* Analyze each local market through competitive shops, daily reports, and monthly revenue reports from the IGB.
* Champion marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns, ensuring effective implementation across all locations.
* Provide strategic direction to the leadership team to drive successful marketing initiatives and promotions.

**Safety, Security, and Systems**

* Maintain a safe working environment by overseeing safety programs, ensuring concerns are reported and resolved.
* Ensure key and alarm code tracking, camera monitoring, and security procedures are followed at all locations.
* Ensure internal systems such as ShiftNotes, Guardian, and the Point-of-Sale system are maintained and updated.

**Facilities, Vendors, and Risk Management**

* Oversee repair and maintenance programs to ensure equipment, facilities, and systems operate efficiently.
* Take a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational risk before problems escalate.
* Manage key vendor, contractor, and partner relationships, including negotiating and reviewing service agreements in partnership with the CEO.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other duties as requested by the CEO.

**Skills & Experience:**

* Must be 21 years of age.
* Extensive multi-unit or multi-location leadership experience, including leading managers and directors.
* Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
* Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
* Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
* Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
* Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
* Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
* Attend meetings and trainings as required.

**Description:**

The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.

More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us *us*: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.

This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.

**Expectations:**

* Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
* Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
* Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
* Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
* Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
* Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Executive Leadership and Culture**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
* Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
* Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
* Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
* Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.

* Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
* Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
* Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
* Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
* Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.

* Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
* Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.

* Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
* Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
* Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
* Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
* Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
* Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
* Attend meetings and trainings as required.

card.title: Director of Rental Operations - East
card.description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for the overall safety, manufacturing performance, and continuous improvement, of multiple manufacturing locations. Responsible for safety and environmental compliance, product quality, delivery performance, meeting customer lead time needs, and cost or financial objectives.

**Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities**

* Manages the daily operations of multiple manufacturing locations for the company and its various components, ensuring compliance with company, local, state, and federal policies and regulations.
* Develops and executes objectives to meet overall plant financial performance through a management operating system supporting safety, quality, delivery, throughput, and cost. Responsible for overall inventory management and ownership overall location performance.
* Leads a team of Manufacturing Engineers, Plant Managers, Site Leaders, Production Supervisors, Planners, Sourcing and others to support daily operations. Works cross functionally with EHS and central Sourcing, Quality, Human Resources, IT and Engineering functions to meet business needs.
* Creates a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. Assures a daily leadboard management process is in place with daily communication to teams on objectives and execution.
* Follows up with teams to assure corrective action and recovery plans are in place as needed. Lead monthly communication meetings with associates in locations to assure they are aware of performance and opportunities for improvement.
* Develops annual operating budgets and provides fiscal direction. Manages to assure inventory and financial objects are met. Develop and execute capital plan for the manufacturing locations.
* Develops or assists with the development and implementation of policies and procedures consistent with those of the organization to ensure efficient and safe/compliant operation. Develops and assists with developing manufacturing plant strategy for the business.
* Represents the organization at various community and/or business meetings.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Nature and Scope**

* Problems are typically defined by higher level leadership. Problems are difficult. Solutions require analysis and investigation.
* Decides how to achieve planned results within an organization's plans, policies, and guidelines. May set or change plans/goals within respective department or area.
* May manage department via multiple layers of managers OR directly supervise a staff of professional individual contributors at the senior or technical advisor level.

**Work Environment**

* Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
* Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
* Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

**Education and Experience**

* Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 9+ years of experience in a related field, including several years in a management/supervisory capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior plant management experience.
* Multi plant management responsibility.

If you’re looking to play a role in building America, consider one of our open opportunities. We can’t wait to meet you.

**Pay Range**

$234,440.00-$375,100.00 Annual

Ohio law requires the posting of the salary range for advertised jobs. This range is determined based on market data and internal pay practices to establish a minimum and maximum value for a job. Individual base pay is determined based on a variety of elements including experience, skills, internal equity and other factors. For additional details on benefits, please review the full job description on White Cap Jobs (https://whitecap.jobs/)

**Work Type** Hybrid

**Req ID** WCJR-037367

White Cap is an Equal Opportunity Minority/Female/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veteran and Affirmative Action Employer.
